title: Tokyo Ravens Novelist Kōhei Azano Plans to End Series in 18th Volume (Updated)
content: The school supernatural fantasy light novel series centers around Harutora, a boy from a branch of the Tsuchimikado family of onmyōdō occult practitioners. However, he lacks the ability to see spirit energy, so he is now just an ordinary high school student.

title: Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 Anime Reveals Teaser Promo Video, More Cast
content: Kadokawa revealed at the " Dengeki Bunko Aki no Saiten Online 2026" livestream event on Saturday a teaser promotional video for the second season of the Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf anime. The event also revealed Romi Park is joining the cast as Eve Bolan. The anime will debut in 2027.

title: 'Keroro Gunsou☆' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official X account for the new television anime adaptation of Mine Yoshizaki 's Keroro Gunsou ( Sgt. Frog ) manga announced three additional cast members on Saturday. The anime series premiered on October 3 at 9:30 a.m. on TV Tokyo.

title: Surprise Anime Creator Reveals They’re Secretly Behind New Sci-Fi Action Hit Despite Retirement
content: The 2000s were a crucial era for the anime industry as they marked the global mainstream breakout of anime shows and movies. The series transitioned from analog cel production to digital animation, which was around the same time there was a major television boom in the West.

title: It’s Official, Gintama Just Got Its Own Holiday
content: Written and illustrated by Hideaki Sorachi, Gintama became one of the most beloved anime and manga franchises of all time. The manga began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2003 and reached its conclusion in 2019.
